citations.quote: 我看了傳聞，將信將疑。想想當年$中国华融(02799)$ 也強調公司一切經營正常
會不會有神秘資金到處買流量免費輸送給新东方，甚至動員各方人馬直接去直播間採購，做大GMV，然後在股市上收割？

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: When a company answers negative rumors with 'all operations are normal', the author stays 將信將疑 (half-believing), recalling that 中国华融 stressed the same line before its blowup. He also sketches a cynical hypothesis for sudden engineered rallies — mysterious capital inflating traffic/GMV to harvest the stock — and gives the falsification test: watch whether GMV collapses the next month.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Skeptic of denials: 將信將疑 toward "operations normal" statements and engineered rallies
